Surprise: my company just announced we’re all marching back into the office. So now I’m anxiously wondering: is it possible to cancel just the home office items — or return them if they’ve already shipped — and keep the hiking stuff? If so, how much would I get back, and can the refund go to my original payment method?

If partial cancellation isn’t allowed, no worries — I’ll just keep the whole order — but in that case, could you switch my default profile address to the Seattle parents’ house that’s already on the order? I’d rather not paste the actual address here in chat. Thanks for helping a slightly frazzled guy out!
